name: read_file
description: Read a text file of your worktree. Give `path` relative to the root of the worktree. Without a range you get the whole file (cut at 256 KiB, and the cut is marked); with `start_line` and `end_line` you get just those lines, each behind its number. A binary file is not shown. Use it to read before you change something, and run_command (`ls`, `grep -rn`) to find where to look.

path.description: Path of the file, relative to the root of the worktree (no `..`, nothing inside `.git`)

start_line.description: First line to show, counting from 1. Leave out to read from the top.

end_line.description: Last line to show. Leave out to read to the end of the file (or of what fits).
